From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>

Subject: VP/CTO sync + technical deep-dive — scheduling & pre-read

Alicia / Tom — thanks again for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

Summary from today
- Primary use case: model-driven personalization across product recommendations and messaging; high QPS with strict latency targets for key flows.
- Success criteria: cut inference cost per request by 40% vs current infra and hit p95 latency < 120ms for short prompt paths.
- Main blockers: executive alignment on residency and compliance constraints; security team needs a short integration checklist.

Proposed next meetings (goal: unblock pilot kickoff)
1) VP / CTO intro (30 minutes) — align on commercial runway, security posture expectations, and target SLOs
2) Technical deep-dive (60 minutes) — infra footprint, sample request volumes, deployment options (hosted vs private), and pilot acceptance criteria

Availability windows we can accommodate next week (all PT):
- Tue 2028-07-17: 10:00–10:30 (VP/CTO intro)
- Wed 2028-07-18: 11:00–12:00 (technical deep-dive)
If those don't work, share a couple windows and we'll try to match.

What we'll bring
- Short Mutual Action Plan (attached) with proposed milestones and owners
- Pre-read one-pager on Redwood runtime and expected perf/cost tradeoffs
- Solution engineer (Karthik) on the deep-dive to go through architecture and integration checklist

Attachments: FinVista_MAP_v0.9.pdf (MAP), redwood-inference-product-one-pager.pdf (product one-pager)

Next step: can you confirm availability for the VP/CTO intro and whether Tom or another security lead should join the deep-dive?

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
